hunks.baseline: *Advance ahead with the army and seize the city? That’s different from the order Regimental Commander Shao gave me.*
hunks.sol: *Advance ahead of the others with the army and seize the city? That’s not what Regimental Commander Shao ordered.*

hunks.baseline: The doubt Zhang Wei had been harboring only grew when they deliberately bypassed the allied forces engaged in combat ahead of them and continued their advance.
hunks.sol: His doubts only deepened when they went out of their way to bypass the friendly forces fighting up ahead.

hunks.baseline: “Senior Colonel Wang. Are you certain our regimental commander approved this operation?”
hunks.sol: “Senior Colonel Wang, are you certain our regimental commander approved this operation?”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you curious about that?”
hunks.sol: “Why do you ask?”

hunks.baseline: “No matter how I look at it, something seems wrong. Our regimental commander clearly told us to conserve our strength in the rear and guard headquarters…”
hunks.sol: “No matter how I look at it, something seems wrong. Our regimental commander clearly ordered us to conserve our strength in the rear and guard headquarters…”

hunks.baseline: “Regimental Commander Shao Shen holds the same rank as you, Senior Colonel Wang. And he’s about to be promoted to major general.”
hunks.sol: “Regimental Commander Shao Shen holds the same rank as you, Senior Colonel Wang. And he’ll soon be promoted to major general.”

hunks.baseline: “That ignorant child was simply lucky. Awakening as an A-rank Hunter wasn’t enough—thanks to that Korean bastard’s performance, he even ended up on this promotion list. Considering how quickly he’s risen through the ranks, I wonder if he has some decent guanxi in political circles.”[^1]
hunks.sol: “That ignorant child simply got lucky. As if awakening as an A-rank Hunter weren’t enough, that Korean bastard’s performance landed him on the promotion list too. Considering how quickly he’s risen through the ranks, perhaps he has some decent guanxi in political circles.”[^1]

hunks.baseline: “He may be young, but he’s just as capable. He’s also well respected enough that he treats us like brothers.”
hunks.sol: “He may be young, but he’s earned his position. He’s also highly respected and treats us like brothers.”

hunks.baseline: The senior officer stroked the baton in his hand.
hunks.sol: The senior officer ran a hand along the baton he was holding.

hunks.baseline: “I know Hunters don’t recognize rank and seniority the way ordinary soldiers do. But this is wartime. This order came from Senior General Liao, the commander.”
hunks.sol: “I’m well aware that you Hunters don’t care much for rank or seniority. But this is wartime. The order came from Senior General Liao, our commander.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. So if you don’t want to follow the order, turn back now. But I hope you understand that what you’re doing constitutes disobeying orders.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. So if you don’t want to obey, turn back now. Just understand that doing so will constitute disobeying orders.”

hunks.baseline: “I merely want to shorten our advance time. The circumstances make it unlikely, but if any monsters remain, we’ll wipe them out and rescue any civilians in danger. That’s all. Understood?”
hunks.sol: “All we’re trying to do is speed up our advance. It seems unlikely under the circumstances, but if any monsters remain, we’ll wipe them out and rescue any civilians in danger. That’s all. Understood?”

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei remained silent for a long while before nodding and stepping away.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei remained silent for a long moment before nodding and stepping away.

hunks.baseline: The Public Security Armed Forces were generally treated as a separate organization outside the military, but this was wartime. Defying Senior General Liao, the commander of the western front, was by no means a wise choice.
hunks.sol: The Public Security Armed Forces were normally treated as an organization separate from the military, but this was wartime. Defying Senior General Liao, commander of the western front, would not be a wise choice.

hunks.baseline: A subordinate asked in a lowered voice. Zhang Wei answered.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei answered his subordinate’s hushed question.

hunks.baseline: “He says it’s an easy operation, so we should shut up and follow him. Refusing would constitute disobedience.”
hunks.sol: “He says it’s an easy operation, so we should shut up and follow him. If we refuse, it’s disobeying orders.”

hunks.baseline: “If you’re asking about the first part, of course not. But the second part is probably true. What do you think?”
hunks.sol: “If you mean the first part, of course not. But the second part is probably true. What do you think?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course I don’t believe him. That bastard Senior Colonel Wang has risen this far on a single connection to the Princelings despite having no ability. Everyone says he’s Senior General Liao’s lapdog.”
hunks.sol: “Of course I don’t believe him. That bastard Wang is incompetent. He only rose this far because of a single connection to the Princelings. Everyone knows he’s Senior General Liao’s lapdog.”

hunks.baseline: “And this is an order from that very Senior General Liao. We’ll have to endure it for now, even if it smells rotten.”
hunks.sol: “And this order came from that very Senior General Liao. For now, we’ll have to endure the stench, however rotten it smells.”

hunks.baseline: “But Senior Colonel Wang might be telling the truth. Most of the monsters in the area are probably engaged with our forces. With our current strength, we should be more than capable of handling a few stragglers.”
hunks.sol: “But Wang might be telling the truth. Most of the monsters in the area should already be engaged with our forces. With our current strength, we can handle a few stragglers.”

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei looked around him. In addition to the hundred Hunters, including himself, there were around twenty tanks and five hundred infantrymen. Three combat helicopters were advancing overhead, securing their field of vision.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei looked around. In addition to the hundred Hunters under his command, there were around twenty tanks and five hundred infantrymen. Three combat helicopters flew overhead, scouting the way ahead.

hunks.baseline: *Please, let there be no casualties.*
hunks.sol: *Please, let us get through this without any serious losses.*

hunks.baseline: Perhaps Zhang Wei’s wish had reached the heavens. The thing he had feared did not happen.
hunks.sol: Perhaps Zhang Wei’s wish reached the heavens, because what he feared did not come to pass.

hunks.baseline: The small town near Suining City, which they entered with every sense alert, had been utterly devastated by monsters. Apart from that, the ruined downtown area was deathly silent.
hunks.sol: The small town near Suining City had been devastated by monsters, but when they entered with every sense on alert, the ruined streets were deathly silent.

hunks.baseline: Monsters such as goblins and orcs occasionally sprang out, but they posed no threat whatsoever.
hunks.sol: The occasional goblin or orc sprang out at them, but they posed no threat whatsoever.

hunks.baseline: After killing a dozen or so monsters at the very front, Zhang Wei felt slightly more at ease.
hunks.sol: After cutting down a dozen or so monsters at the head of the column, Zhang Wei relaxed slightly.

hunks.baseline: “Seeing how monsters of different species are appearing separately, they must be stragglers that broke away from the main group.”
hunks.sol: “Different species are appearing on their own. They must be stragglers that broke away from the main horde.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: The officer’s arrogant manner was irritating, but this was still preferable.
hunks.sol: The officer’s smug response grated on him, but this was still better than the alternative.

hunks.baseline: Thinking so, Zhang Wei silently nodded. Then he froze at the senior officer’s next words.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei silently nodded—then froze at the senior officer’s next words.

hunks.baseline: “You want us to split up our forces?”
hunks.sol: “You want us to split our forces?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. In a situation like this, we need to find survivors as quickly as possible.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. Under these circumstances, finding survivors as quickly as possible should be our priority.”

hunks.baseline: “But Senior Colonel Wang, we haven’t even been inside for an hour yet. We should advance a little farther toward the center first…”
hunks.sol: “But Senior Colonel Wang, we haven’t even been inside the city for an hour. We should advance farther toward the center before—”

hunks.baseline: “You Hunters may be better at combat, but I’m several moves ahead of you when it comes to tactics. I hold command authority at present, so stop talking and follow my orders.”
hunks.sol: “You Hunters may be better in a fight, but I’m several steps ahead of you when it comes to tactics. I currently hold command authority, so shut your mouth and follow my orders.”

hunks.baseline: “Didn’t you hear me? Should I issue the order directly to your subordinates?”
hunks.sol: “Didn’t you hear me? Or should I give the order directly to your subordinates?”

hunks.baseline: “You have a detailed map, I assume. Then we’ll meet at the central square in two hours.”
hunks.sol: “You have a detailed map, I assume. We’ll meet in the central square in two hours.”

hunks.baseline: The officer gave Zhang Wei a hateful smile and was about to climb into an armored vehicle when—
hunks.sol: The officer gave Zhang Wei a spiteful smile and turned to climb into an armored vehicle.
At that exact moment—

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei blinked blankly. When he wiped his face with his palm, it came away covered in sticky blood.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei blinked, dazed. He wiped his face with one palm, and it came away covered in sticky blood.

hunks.baseline: The substance was unmistakably human blood, bright red without end. The officer’s body, already missing its entire upper half, rolled out of the armored vehicle.
hunks.sol: The vivid crimson blood was unmistakably human. Beside him, the officer’s body—its entire upper half gone without a trace—rolled out of the armored vehicle.
A suffocating silence descended.

hunks.baseline: A suffocating silence descended. Zhang Wei was the first to regain his senses.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei was the first to regain his senses.

hunks.baseline: “Tank!”
hunks.sol: “Tanks!”

hunks.baseline: “T-The regimental commander has been killed!”
hunks.sol: “Th-The regimental commander has been killed!”

hunks.baseline: The Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces were the first to react to the shouts. The soldiers understood what was happening a moment later.
hunks.sol: The Public Security Armed Forces Hunters were the first to respond to the shouts. The soldiers grasped the situation a moment later.

hunks.baseline: And waiting for them, already thrown into utter chaos by their commander’s sudden death, was an even more horrific death.
hunks.sol: Already thrown into utter chaos by their commander’s sudden death, what awaited them next was an even more gruesome end.

hunks.baseline: A single sound of air being split.
hunks.sol: A single shriek tore through the air.

hunks.baseline: A streak of light fired at an invisible speed swept across the soldiers marching in orderly ranks.
hunks.sol: A streak of light, moving too fast to see, swept through the soldiers marching in orderly ranks.

hunks.baseline: The streak of light burst dozens of people like balloons as it advanced, then finally pierced the armored vehicle moving under the protection of the infantry.
hunks.sol: It burst dozens of people like balloons before finally piercing an armored vehicle moving under infantry escort.

hunks.baseline: It broke through the vehicle’s hard outer shell and burrowed deep inside. The sight made Zhang Wei shout like a thunderclap.
hunks.sol: The streak punched through its tough outer shell and buried itself deep inside. The sight made Zhang Wei bellow like thunder.

hunks.baseline: But before his voice could reach them, the thunderous roar that erupted the next moment swallowed everything.
hunks.sol: But before his warning could reach them, a deafening explosion swallowed everything.

hunks.baseline: The armored vehicle exploded in a red flash and black smoke. Its fragments became hundreds, thousands of blades, tearing into everything around them.
hunks.sol: The armored vehicle erupted in a red flash and a cloud of black smoke. Hundreds—thousands—of fragments became blades that tore through everything around it.

hunks.baseline: Soldiers and lower-ranking Hunters who failed to react in time alike fell like sheaves of straw. Countless bodies collapsed.
hunks.sol: Soldiers and lower-ranking Hunters who had failed to react in time collapsed like sheaves of straw. Too many to count fell where they stood.

hunks.baseline: Those who were already dead did not move even an inch.
hunks.sol: Their lifeless bodies did not so much as twitch.

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei shouted at the people frozen like statues.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei roared at the people standing frozen like statues.

hunks.baseline: But the soldiers, experiencing real combat for the first time in their lives, were frozen in place. And their opponent, who had yet to reveal itself, never failed to take advantage of the enemy’s confusion.
hunks.sol: But the soldiers were experiencing real combat for the first time in their lives, and their bodies refused to move. Their still-unseen opponent did not let the confusion go to waste.
The sound of death rang out again.

hunks.baseline: The sound of death rang out once again. But unlike before, there was more than one streak of light.
hunks.sol: This time, however, there was more than one streak of light.

hunks.baseline: Flames erupted, and screams flooded the air.
hunks.sol: Flames surged upward, and screams flooded the air.

hunks.baseline: The roughly twenty armored vehicles and tanks were disabled in the blink of an eye.
hunks.sol: The roughly twenty tanks and armored vehicles were disabled in the blink of an eye.

hunks.baseline: Amid the horrific scene that could only be called a mountain of corpses and sea of blood, Zhang Wei felt a chill run down his spine.
hunks.sol: Amid the horrific scene—a veritable mountain of corpses and sea of blood—Zhang Wei felt a chill run down his spine.

hunks.baseline: *At least an A-rank monster. And not just one or two.*
hunks.sol: *At least A-rank monsters. And there’s more than one.*

hunks.baseline: Ironically, it was the most accurate judgment Zhang Wei would make that day.
hunks.sol: Ironically, that was the most accurate judgment Zhang Wei made all day.

hunks.baseline: Between dark alleys and collapsed buildings, atop a still-burning building—
hunks.sol: Between dark alleys and collapsed buildings. Atop a building that was still burning.

hunks.baseline: A groan escaped Zhang Wei’s lips when he spotted the figures mounted on warhorses stripped down to their bones.
hunks.sol: A groan escaped Zhang Wei’s lips when he spotted the figures mounted on warhorses stripped down to the bone.

hunks.baseline: The very Death Knights that had vanished from sight after the Great Cataclysm along with the Lich had appeared. And there were no fewer than ten of them.
hunks.sol: The Death Knights that had vanished after the Great Cataclysm along with the Lich had reappeared.
Ten of them.

hunks.baseline: The first word that came to Zhang Wei’s mind was death.
hunks.sol: The first word that came to Zhang Wei’s mind was *death*.

hunks.baseline: Death Knights were beings that had surpassed A-rank monsters.
hunks.sol: Death Knights were beings that surpassed A-rank monsters.

hunks.baseline: A hundred Hunters and the military forces still remained, but Zhang Wei already knew.
hunks.sol: A hundred Hunters and part of the military force still remained, but Zhang Wei already knew.

hunks.baseline: They could not escape the net that had been spread around them.
hunks.sol: There would be no escaping the net they had cast.

hunks.baseline: That thought did not belong to Zhang Wei alone.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei was not alone in that thought.

hunks.baseline: Unlike the soldiers, who were so terrified they could barely hold their guns properly, the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces raised their weapons with eyes full of resolve.
hunks.sol: Unlike the soldiers, who were so terrified they could barely hold their guns, the Public Security Armed Forces Hunters raised their weapons, their eyes filled with resolve.

hunks.baseline: One of the platoon commanders answered Zhang Wei’s quiet words bluntly.
hunks.sol: One of the platoon commanders answered Zhang Wei’s quiet words with a blunt question.

hunks.baseline: “And you do?”
hunks.sol: “But you do?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have brought you here.”
hunks.sol: “I’m sorry. I never should have brought you here.”

hunks.baseline: “No one brought us. We followed you. We’ve survived more than ten times thanks to you, Company Commander. It was about time we faced something like this at least once.”
hunks.sol: “You didn’t bring us. We followed you. You’ve saved our lives more than ten times, Company Commander. I’d say it’s about time we faced something like this for you.”

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei licked his parched lips as he stared at the ten Death Knights that remained perfectly still.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei licked his parched lips as he stared at the ten motionless Death Knights.

hunks.baseline: A thunderous cheer erupted in place of an answer. The Hunters’ eyes, their fear driven away, shone like morning stars.
hunks.sol: A thunderous cheer erupted in place of an answer. With their fear driven away, the Hunters’ eyes shone like morning stars.

hunks.baseline: If they had wanted safe and prosperous lives, they could have chosen another path.
hunks.sol: If they had wanted safe, prosperous lives, they could have chosen another path.

hunks.baseline: But they had chosen the Public Security Armed Forces over becoming bodyguards for wealthy entrepreneurs or mercenaries because of their honor and sense of responsibility as Hunters.
hunks.sol: But instead of becoming bodyguards for wealthy entrepreneurs or working as mercenaries, they had joined the Public Security Armed Forces out of honor and a sense of responsibility as Hunters.

hunks.baseline: “Forward! Sons and daughters of the people, descendants of Zhonghua!”
hunks.sol: “Forward! Sons and daughters of the people! Descendants of Zhonghua!”

hunks.baseline: Just as Zhang Wei roared with all his strength and was about to charge toward the nearest Death Knight—
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei roared with all his strength and was about to charge the nearest Death Knight when—

hunks.baseline: It was almost instinctive.
hunks.sol: It was pure instinct.

hunks.baseline: A tremendous force accompanied the violent tremors. The surviving humans turned their heads, terror making every hair on their bodies stand on end.
hunks.sol: A tremendous force rolled over them with the violent tremors. Every hair on their bodies standing on end with terror, the surviving humans turned their heads.

hunks.baseline: Where countless eyes turned, a black knight was slowly crossing the ruined downtown area.
hunks.sol: Countless eyes fixed on a black knight slowly crossing the ruined downtown district.

hunks.baseline: Red eyes flashed beneath a helmet pulled low. The breath of death poured from between its bloodless lips.
hunks.sol: Red eyes flashed beneath his low-set helmet. The breath of death poured from between his bloodless lips.

hunks.baseline: A language of the demon realm that no one could understand.
hunks.sol: Words in a language of the demon realm that none of them could understand.

hunks.baseline: But the next moment, Zhang Wei realized what the words meant.
hunks.sol: And yet, in the next moment, Zhang Wei realized what they meant.

hunks.baseline: The ten Death Knights charging from every direction were reflected in Zhang Wei’s wide-open eyes.
hunks.sol: The ten Death Knights charging from every direction were reflected in Zhang Wei’s wide eyes.

hunks.baseline: The Death Knights approached the black knight, who was gazing down at the corpse of Zhang Wei, the middle-aged Hunter who had resisted until the very end, and dropped to one knee.
hunks.sol: The Death Knights approached the black knight as he gazed down at the corpse of Zhang Wei, the middle-aged Hunter who had resisted to the very end, and dropped to one knee.

hunks.baseline: —Lord. Awaiting your next command.
hunks.sol: —Lord. Your next command.

hunks.baseline: After remaining silent for a moment, the black knight suddenly extended a hand.
hunks.sol: After a moment of silence, the black knight suddenly extended a hand.

hunks.baseline: A black streak of light, swung like a whip, cut through concrete and rebar.
hunks.sol: A black streak of light lashed out like a whip, cutting through concrete and rebar.

hunks.baseline: The building collapsed at an angle. Inside the exposed space, humans were crouched together with their hands clamped tightly over their mouths.
hunks.sol: The building collapsed at an angle. Within the newly exposed interior, several humans crouched with their hands clamped tightly over their mouths.

hunks.baseline: “Jinjin. Honey. It’s okay, it’s okay…”
hunks.sol: “Jinjin. Honey. It’s okay. It’s okay…”

hunks.baseline: A human male and female. And…
hunks.sol: A human male and female.
And…

hunks.baseline: A being so small and light that it was impossible to tell whether it was male or female.
hunks.sol: A being so infinitely small and light that it was impossible to distinguish whether it was male or female.

hunks.baseline: The black knight pushed the question aside and extended his hand. The humans within sight had to be annihilated. That was the order he had received.
hunks.sol: The black knight pushed the sudden question aside and extended his hand. Every human within sight had to be annihilated.
Those were the orders he had received.

hunks.baseline: For some reason, his hand would not move forward.
hunks.sol: For some reason, his hand would not move.

hunks.baseline: The creatures were clearly so weak that the snap of a finger would turn them into a handful of blood and make them disappear. And yet it was as if an invisible barrier surrounded them.
hunks.sol: They were weak creatures, so fragile that a snap of his fingers would reduce them to a handful of blood. Yet it was as though an invisible barrier surrounded them.

hunks.baseline: At the black knight’s eerie voice, the child wriggling in its parents’ arms suddenly burst into a wailing cry.
hunks.sol: At the black knight’s eerie voice, the child squirming in its parents’ arms suddenly burst into a wail.

hunks.baseline: The black knight abruptly lifted its head and looked into the distance before turning its horse around.
hunks.sol: The black knight abruptly raised his head and stared into the distance, then wheeled his horse around.

hunks.baseline: The Death Knights questioned their leader’s sudden movement.
hunks.sol: The Death Knights questioned their leader’s sudden action.

hunks.baseline: —We’re leaving. Now. At once.
hunks.sol: —We’re returning. Now. At once.

hunks.baseline: —Then we’ll take care of the humans—
hunks.sol: —Then we will take care of the humans—

hunks.baseline: —We’re leaving. Now. At once.
hunks.sol: —We’re returning. Now. At once.

hunks.baseline: Just before they vanished like mist, the black knight’s red eyes touched the three humans who had survived by a miracle, then moved away.
hunks.sol: Just before they vanished like mist, the black knight’s red eyes settled on the three humans who had survived by a miracle, then moved away.

hunks.baseline: A wind carrying the smell of blood swept through the ruins filled with corpses.
hunks.sol: A wind heavy with the smell of blood swept through the corpse-filled ruins.
